_source: Typed by hand from docs/PROJECT-PLAN.md section 1 (Stages each track sees). Independent oracle: never generate this file from the prototype.
_scope: The nine track lists, counts and questionsPerTrack below describe PROTOTYPE-OWNED CONTENT ONLY, and must stay that way. ops/seed/seed-content.ts and ops/seed/verify-seed.ts read a track's stages filtered to the prototype's own codes and compare that list against the array here; a stage from any other source added to one of these arrays would make every prototype seed report a MISMATCH and roll itself back. Content a pack adds goes in packStages instead.
_packStages: Stages that a content pack adds to a track, also typed by hand — from the pack's own source document, never read back from a database. 'after' is the stage the new one follows in unlock order; composing a track's real list means inserting each entry after its anchor. 'badge' is what the card shows (display_num); it is deliberately not the code, because the code is the identity that stage_completions, quiz_attempts and lesson_progress point at and so never moves when the module does.
